bullets: Added byok list, add, update, validate, select, remove, and off subcommands for managing your own provider keys.
Added the ability to choose your own inference provider during a Freebuff session, bypassing the platform-provided model.
Fixed /byok so quoted provider names are parsed literally without evaluating shell syntax.
The CLI now re-exports the Freebucks row-intent logic from a shared module used by both CLI and session code.
When the Freebucks meter balance is unavailable, the assistant now asks for spending consent before proceeding.
Freebucks row-intent wording now survives rate-limited and spend-limited responses during session synthesis.
A resumed run can switch from hosted inference to your own provider keys exactly once.
After switching a resumed run from hosted inference to your own provider keys, the system keeps using your keys and blocks reversals.
Added iOS ad placements (iOS-Chat-After-Assistant-Message, iOS-Coding-After-User-Message, iOS-Coding-After-Assistant-Message) to the placements rail.
iOS native ad inventory is now registered as its own attributable surface separate from web or CLI slots.
Deleted the CLI helper that formatted validation errors into tidy clickable links in chat messages.
When a new session is refused due to capacity, the refusal now includes the exact admission bucket and slot limit that blocked it.
Older servers still omit the new capacity fields, so clients must not guess limits from the refusal message.
Added a yearly billing interval type so subscription tiers can offer annual plans.
Subscription tier offers now include an optional yearly price alongside the monthly price.
Subscription info now carries billing interval, renews-at timestamp, and source fields.
Advertisers on the postpaid plan now start with a $200 credit line when saving a payment card, up from $100.
The higher postpaid starting credit line now requires card verification before it can be used to deliver ads.
Added a yearly billing interval type and tier offer fields for annual subscription pricing.
Added a Gravity Showcase experiment that buckets users into treatment and control groups for ad placement evaluation.
Added a showcase presentation event to track when the Gravity Showcase ad placement is shown.
Created a new experiment module for the Gravity Showcase ad placement evaluation.
